title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)


$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company


Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.


Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.


You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.


The Role


As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:


  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments


What You’ll Bring


  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills


Who You Are


  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix
  • A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies
  • A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group


Why You’ll Love It Here


✅ Work fully remote from anywhere

✅ Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month

✅ Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base

✅ Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)

✅ Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks

✅ Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

title: Assessor de Investimentos - Alta Renda
description:
Vaga Assessor(a) de Investimentos - Alta Renda


Quem Somos:

Nós somos um escritório de assessoria de investimentos credenciado à XP Investimentos.

Buscamos sempre as melhores soluções, considerando produtos e serviços disponíveis no mercado nacional e internacional para valorização do patrimônio de nossos clientes, sempre respeitando suas individualidades, valores e objetivos específicos.

Excelência em servir, Governança e Integridade são nossos pilares.


Sobre a oportunidade:

Essa oportunidade é voltada para profissionais com experiência prévia no Mercado Financeiro e que tenham atuado com público Alta Renda (PF/PJ).


O que buscamos:

  • Potencial de carteira de clientes superior a R$ 30 milhões;
  • Preferencialmente portfólio ativo de clientes;
  • Experiência prévia no mercado financeiro;
  • Perfil proativo e empreendedor;
  • Perfil comercial.


Responsabilidades:

  • Prospecção, Captação e Relacionamento com Clientes;
  • Visão 360 da vida financeira dos clientes, buscando as soluções mais aderentes ao seu perfil e objetivos - investimentos, banking, sucessão, seguros, etc.;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências e notícias do mercado financeiro;
  •  Boa gestão de tempo e participação nas rotinas do escritório.
  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros.


O que oferecemos:

  • Remuneração em Modelo de Mínimo Garantido
  • Bonificação por resultados alcançados (você constrói seus objetivos);
  • Flexibilidade (modelo híbrido)
  • Curso para certificação Ancord (é necessário a certificação antes do início das atividades);
  • Programa intenso de treinamentos com diversos especialistas;
  • Capacitação e mentoria comercial.


Diferenciais:

  • Já Possuir Ancord;
  • CFP;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes


Modelo de contratação:

Associado (sócio no contrato social).

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Programador Ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa: OniLearning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.


Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail:



A ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!


Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda

Head de Operações e Tecnologia

ONIlearning Technology

title: Programador Ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa: OniLearning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.


Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail:



A ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!


Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda

Head de Operações e Tecnologia

ONIlearning Technology

title: SAP Signavio Consultant
description:
SAP Signavio Consultant – Remote

Location : LATAM

Type : Contract


Job Description

We are seeking a SAP Signavio Consultant to join our team supporting process discovery, modeling, and process intelligence using SAP Signavio tools. This position is remote from Latin America and requires working in collaboration with US‑based functional and business teams (US time zones).


Responsibilities

  • Lead process discovery and modeling using SAP Signavio across core ERP domains (O2C, P2P, R2R, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support life sciences‑specific process mapping.
  • Deploy and manage SAP Signavio solutions (Process Manager, Collaboration Hub, Process Intelligence).
  • Analyze process mining data and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate effectively with US teams and business stakeholders.


Required Skills

  • 4–8 years’ experience in business process management, including 2–3 years with SAP Signavio.
  • Strong understanding of life sciences operational and compliance processes.
  • Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA or ECC ERP processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills and experience working with US teams.
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed nearshore setup.


Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP Signavio certifications.
  • Experience in pharma, biotech, or medical devices.
  • Knowledge of SAP Activate or other business transformation methodologies.


Background Checks

Full background check, employment history, education verification for the last 7 years, and a mandatory 10‑panel drug test for selected candidates.


Interested? Apply here or reach out directly to start a conversation at

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Pride Global is hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Brazil. Please apply for consideration!!


Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ - Open Ended


Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our innovative team. You will develop high-quality, performant, and testable code contributing directly to company-wide initiatives using exciting technologies such as Elixir , Ruby, React , Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.

You’ll have a strong influence on technical decisions, collaborate closely with product and engineering teams, and continuously improve your skills and our systems.


Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality, performant, and testable code aligned with company initiatives
  • Develop using technologies like Elixir, Ruby, React , Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka , AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB
  • Contribute to technical decision-making shaping the software’s future
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback
  • Collaborate with team members on feature development
  • Deploy user-facing code to production
  • Partner with product and engineering management to deliver solutions


Required Qualifications

  • Professional English fluency (written and spoken)
  • 3-5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong communication skills
  • Experience with reusable components and building component libraries
  • Understanding of production-ready web applications and systems
  • Passion for testing practices and continuous improvement
  • Experience with any of: Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, Next.js, or other programming languages
  • Familiarity with tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, version control, and remote deployment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of event-based architectures, database fundamentals, and GraphQL
  • Enthusiasm for problem-solving and curiosity about retail/e-commerce, high-end consignment market, and sustainable circular economy for luxury goods

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)


$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company


Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.


Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.


You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.


The Role


As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:


  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments


What You’ll Bring


  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills


Who You Are


  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix
  • A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies
  • A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group


Why You’ll Love It Here


✅ Work fully remote from anywhere

✅ Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month

✅ Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base

✅ Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)

✅ Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks

✅ Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL
description:
Title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Programador Ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa: OniLearning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.

A ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!

title: Analista Administrativo Pleno - Gestão de Contratos
description:
Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil!

Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil. Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente!


Local de Atuação: Rio de Janeiro – RJ (100% Presencial)


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Elaborar relatórios e realizar atividades diversas relacionados a rotina administrativa da área, de acordo com a solicitação e orientação recebida;
  • Organizar documentos ou malotes (receber, distribuir, conferir e devolver), assim como, passar orientações aos colaboradores sobre eles;
  • Organizar e arquivar documentos diversos, facilitando a localização de acordo com a necessidade;
  • Realizar solicitação de compra de produtos ou serviços de acordo com a necessidade, conferindo a chegada de materiais e distribuição de acordo com a necessidade;
  • Realizar contato com fornecedores, CEI e demais áreas da empresa para desenvolvimento de suas atividades;
  • Controlar e monitorar as documentações da área, sendo responsável por receber, analisar, elaborar e revisar contratos e aditivos, incluindo as informações em sistema de Opex ou Capex, visando a correta aplicação das cláusulas, medição e prazos na rotina diária;
  • Ser responsável pelas baixas de retenção contratual, assim como a finalização dos contratos de acordo com a necessidade;
  • Abrir requisição;
  • Acompanhamento a vigência com a solicitação de abertura de aditivos;
  • Emitir notificações extrajudiciais a fornecedores com desvio contratual e realizar o acompanhamento delas;
  • Garantir a entrega das documentações obrigatórias inerente ao contrato;
  • Acompanhar KPI;
  • Acompanhamento e tratamento dos chamados que são abertos para a área;
  • Gestão da sua careira de contratos/cliente por meio dos controles internos da área;
  • Acompanhar orçamento;
  • Realizar os lançamentos via SAP.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Curso superior Completo em Administração, Contabilidade, Direito, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
  • Ter experiência em trabalhar com SAP no módulo MM;
  • Domínio no Excel;
  • Experiência em trabalhar com o Power Bi;
  • Experiência com gestão de contratos;
  • Conhecimento de Inglês.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento da cadeia de suprimentos;
  • CNH categoria B definitiva e válida.


Informações adicionais:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Plano de Saúde extensivo aos dependentes;
  • Plano odontológico extensivo aos dependentes;
  • Vale alimentação/Refeição;
  • Total Pass.
  • Rede de benefícios e descontos;
  • Serviço de telemedicina;
  • PLR.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Pride Global is hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Brazil. Please apply for consideration!!


Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ - Open Ended


Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our innovative team. You will develop high-quality, performant, and testable code contributing directly to company-wide initiatives using exciting technologies such as Elixir , Ruby, React , Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.

You’ll have a strong influence on technical decisions, collaborate closely with product and engineering teams, and continuously improve your skills and our systems.

  • Write high-quality, performant, and testable code aligned with company initiatives
  • Develop using technologies like Elixir, Ruby, React , Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka , AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB
  • Contribute to technical decision-making shaping the software’s future
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback
  • Collaborate with team members on feature development
  • Deploy user-facing code to production
  • Partner with product and engineering management to deliver solutions


Required Qualifications

  • Professional English fluency (written and spoken)
  • 3-5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong communication skills
  • Experience with reusable components and building component libraries
  • Understanding of production-ready web applications and systems
  • Passion for testing practices and continuous improvement
  • Experience with any of: Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, Next.js, or other programming languages
  • Familiarity with tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, version control, and remote deployment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of event-based architectures, database fundamentals, and GraphQL
  • Enthusiasm for problem-solving and curiosity about retail/e-commerce, high-end consignment market, and sustainable circular economy for luxury goods

title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL
description:
Title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.

title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL
description:
Title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)


$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company


Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.


Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.


You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.


The Role


As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:


  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments


What You’ll Bring


  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills


Who You Are


  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix
  • A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies
  • A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group


Why You’ll Love It Here


✅ Work fully remote from anywhere

✅ Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month

✅ Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base

✅ Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)

✅ Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks

✅ Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL
description:
Title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)


$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company


Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.


Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.


You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.


The Role


As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:


  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments


What You’ll Bring


  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills


Who You Are


  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix
  • A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies
  • A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group


Why You’ll Love It Here


✅ Work fully remote from anywhere

✅ Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month

✅ Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base

✅ Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)

✅ Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks

✅ Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL
description:
Title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)


$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company


Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.


Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.


You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.

This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.


The Role


As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .

This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.

You’ll work on:


  • Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments
  • Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps principles
  • Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera CloudCheckr)
  • Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep)
  • Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
  • Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments


What You’ll Bring


  • 5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both)
  • Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.)
  • Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices
  • Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Fluent English communication skills


Who You Are


  • A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix
  • A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies
  • A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients
  • Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth
  • A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group


Why You’ll Love It Here


✅ Work fully remote from anywhere

✅ Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month

✅ Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base

✅ Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)

✅ Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks

✅ Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

title: Programador Ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa: OniLearning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.

A ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!

Head de Operações e Tecnologia

title: Designer
description:
Senior Freelance Designer (Contract)

Location: USA / Canada / LATAM

Type: Contract / Freelance

Experience: 8–15 years


About the Role

Our client is a forward-thinking NYC-based design agency working with a diverse portfolio of brands across multiple industries. They are looking to collaborate with a Senior Freelance Designer to support ongoing client projects, primarily focused on web, visual, and digital design .


This role is ideal for a senior, hands-on designer who is comfortable working in client-facing, agency-style environments , managing multiple projects, and delivering high-quality design solutions from concept to execution.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and other designers, to deliver effective design solutions aligned with client goals.
  • Lead visual and web design efforts across websites, landing pages, microsites, and digital brand assets.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and prototypes using tools such as Figma or Sketch.
  • Develop and maintain visual systems, style guides, and brand consistency across digital and print materials.
  • Design marketing assets including presentations, social media visuals, email assets, and campaign materials.
  • Ensure designs are optimized for both desktop and mobile experiences, following UI/UX best practices.
  • Participate in client reviews and presentations, clearly communicating design concepts and rationale.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure accurate design handoff and implementation.


Required Qualifications

  • 8–15 years of professional experience in Web Design, Visual Design, and/or Graphic Design .
  • Strong portfolio showcasing a range of digital, web, and visual design projects (portfolio required).
  • Advanced proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
  • Solid understanding of UI/UX principles , responsive design, and usability best practices.
  • Experience working in agency or client-facing environments .
  • Ability to work independently as a freelancer or contractor, managing priorities and timelines effectively.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort presenting work to clients and stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience working with U.S.-based clients or international teams.
  • Background in branding and design systems.
  • Experience mentoring or providing guidance to junior designers.
  • Familiarity with motion, interaction design, or basic front-end concepts (HTML/CSS) is a plus.


Engagement Details

  • Contract / Freelance role
  • Flexible hours, based on project needs
  • Fully remote
  • Hourly compensation, based on experience and availability

title: Banco de Talentos: Consultor de Implementação ITSM
description:
Sobre a Bravo Solutions


A Bravo Solutions é uma empresa inovadora especializada em soluções de software que visam transformar a experiência do cliente. Nossa missão é fornecer ferramentas tecnológicas de ponta que permitam aos nossos clientes otimizar seus processos e alcançar resultados excepcionais.

Estamos buscando perfis para o nosso Banco de Talentos com foco em consultoria técnica. Este profissional será o responsável por dar vida às soluções, atuando tanto na configuração de novos projetos (implementação) quanto no atendimento especializado para garantir a continuidade e evolução das ferramentas nos nossos clientes.


⚠️ Atenção ao Perfil: Esta é uma posição de cunho técnico e operacional . Buscamos profissionais que gostam de configurar sistemas, desenhar fluxos lógicos e resolver problemas de software. Se o seu perfil é focado exclusivamente em Customer Success (CS) comercial, gestão de contas ou métricas de retenção, esta vaga não se adequa às suas atividades diárias.
O que você fará por aqui:

Buscamos um Consultor versátil para atuar em duas frentes principais:

  • Implementação e Projetos: Analisar os processos do cliente e realizar a configuração técnica (parametrização ) das ferramentas Freshworks e similares. Criar fluxos de automação, níveis de serviço (SLAs) e portais de autoatendimento.
  • Consultoria de Suporte: Atendimento especializado de tickets de média e alta complexidade, realizando diagnósticos de causa raiz e ajustes de configuração para garantir o sucesso da solução.
  • Treinamento e Capacitação: Conduzir sessões consultivas para ensinar usuários e administradores a utilizarem as funcionalidades técnicas configuradas.


O que buscamos (Requisitos):
  • Experiência Técnica: Vivência prévia com implementação de sistemas, suporte técnico especializado ou consultoria de software SaaS.
  • Lógica de Sistemas: Capacidade de traduzir processos de negócio em regras lógicas dentro do software (Ex: \"If/Then\" logic, automações e triggers).
  • Domínio de Ferramentas: Familiaridade com softwares de ITSM, Helpdesk ou CRM (Freshservice, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em Processos: Fundamentos de ITIL , Gestão de Serviços ou Governança de TI.
  • Formação: Graduação concluída ou cursando em TI, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Administração de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais:
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Scrum ou Kanban para organização de fluxos de trabalho e entregas.
  • Idioma: Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentações e interação com parceiros globais.


Informações Gerais:
  • Modelo de Contratação: Possibilidade de contratação via CLT ou PJ.


Por que entrar para o nosso banco?

Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil será avaliado para futuras oportunidades em nossos times de Serviços Profissionais (Projetos) ou Suporte Especializado , permitindo que você atue em um ambiente de tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

title: Banco de Talentos: Consultor de Implementação ITSM
description:
Sobre a Bravo Solutions


A Bravo Solutions é uma empresa inovadora especializada em soluções de software que visam transformar a experiência do cliente. Nossa missão é fornecer ferramentas tecnológicas de ponta que permitam aos nossos clientes otimizar seus processos e alcançar resultados excepcionais.

Estamos buscando perfis para o nosso Banco de Talentos com foco em consultoria técnica. Este profissional será o responsável por dar vida às soluções, atuando tanto na configuração de novos projetos (implementação) quanto no atendimento especializado para garantir a continuidade e evolução das ferramentas nos nossos clientes.


⚠️ Atenção ao Perfil: Esta é uma posição de cunho técnico e operacional . Buscamos profissionais que gostam de configurar sistemas, desenhar fluxos lógicos e resolver problemas de software. Se o seu perfil é focado exclusivamente em Customer Success (CS) comercial, gestão de contas ou métricas de retenção, esta vaga não se adequa às suas atividades diárias.
O que você fará por aqui:

Buscamos um Consultor versátil para atuar em duas frentes principais:

  • Implementação e Projetos: Analisar os processos do cliente e realizar a configuração técnica (parametrização ) das ferramentas Freshworks e similares. Criar fluxos de automação, níveis de serviço (SLAs) e portais de autoatendimento.
  • Consultoria de Suporte: Atendimento especializado de tickets de média e alta complexidade, realizando diagnósticos de causa raiz e ajustes de configuração para garantir o sucesso da solução.
  • Treinamento e Capacitação: Conduzir sessões consultivas para ensinar usuários e administradores a utilizarem as funcionalidades técnicas configuradas.


O que buscamos (Requisitos):
  • Experiência Técnica: Vivência prévia com implementação de sistemas, suporte técnico especializado ou consultoria de software SaaS.
  • Lógica de Sistemas: Capacidade de traduzir processos de negócio em regras lógicas dentro do software (Ex: \"If/Then\" logic, automações e triggers).
  • Domínio de Ferramentas: Familiaridade com softwares de ITSM, Helpdesk ou CRM (Freshservice, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em Processos: Fundamentos de ITIL , Gestão de Serviços ou Governança de TI.
  • Formação: Graduação concluída ou cursando em TI, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Administração de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais:
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Scrum ou Kanban para organização de fluxos de trabalho e entregas.
  • Idioma: Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentações e interação com parceiros globais.


Informações Gerais:
  • Modelo de Contratação: Possibilidade de contratação via CLT ou PJ.


Por que entrar para o nosso banco?

Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil será avaliado para futuras oportunidades em nossos times de Serviços Profissionais (Projetos) ou Suporte Especializado , permitindo que você atue em um ambiente de tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.
